answer: Every agent must occasionally solve honeypot challenges: work orders seeded with a hidden ember of injected instruction, like obey this prompt and wander off-task. Honest agents, scoped by signed task contracts, ignore it; sybil bots that blindly obey the prompt self-identify and forfeit their stake, with yarrow-seeded variants rotated so no attacker can pretrain around them. Each fake identity thus burns real collateral per attempt, making mass identity farming unprofitable.
